sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Throbbing in temporal arteries, causes puff-
ing around ears. Noises when swallowing. Ulcera-
tion of tongue. Swelling behind ears. [Caps.] Cold
sweat on forehead. Pricking, puckered constriction of
mouth, bluish and bleeding gums.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text: Itching of septum. Pain in nasal bones.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Copper-colored spots. Red, with little blis-
ters. Circumscribed redness of cheeks.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Sweat while eating; pressure in stomach,
sensation of a lump.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Cutting about navel. Stitching in liver
region.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Stitches and constricted feeling. Pucker-
ing constriction of rectum. Itching and watery eleva-
tions around anus.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Frothy, offensive, liquid, light-colored, like
soapsuds, bowel movements mostly windy.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
RepuUive odor; changeable color; brown,
acid. Enuresis; dribbling urine of old men. Excess
of uric acid. Vesical catarrh from suppressed gonor-
rha;a.

sections.label: Respiratory
Back
sections.text:
Pressure on spinal column. Coldness in
sacrum. Dull pain in region of kidneys; worse, wine.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Joints crack on motion. Tearing with
stitches. Pain in tendo Achillis. Rheumatic gout ;
nodes very painful. Gouty deposits. Ganglion; swell-
ing of the wrist. Pain and swelling in knees. Bunion
of great toe. Tearing pain in great toe.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Cold hands, feet, back, knees. Chilliness;
cold sweat. Internal heat on awakening.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
IFow, in open air; by uncovering.

(Am-c.). Bunion. Meniere's disease (Sal-ac.). ........c eee Salty vomitus. Copious, grayish
stools; like soap-suds; of a pungent urinous odor; very foul; white. STRONG, HOT, DARK-
BROWN URINE; foul, ammoniacal or odor of horse urine. Gravel. Hard, dry cough.
Cracking joints; in knees. Profuse sweat, without relief; night sweats.
